summary: Sparrow Throttleworks is evaluating Redwood for latency- and cost-sensitive adtech inference: per-impression creative scoring, reranking, and small-embedding store. Primary interest in Dedicated + Optimize to squeeze unit costs via batching, KV/prefix caching, and aggressive quantization while preserving p95/p99 latency SLAs.
performance_requirements: Targets: p95 end-to-end generation <= 80ms for <=64 tokens; p99 <= 200ms. Throughput: burst up to 500 qps, sustained 200 qps. Cost sensitivity: aiming to cut per-1k-token spend >= 30% vs current provider. Must include kernel-level benchmarking (A100/H100) and quantized 4-bit/8-bit runs.
model_preferences: Prefer open models or self-hosted L2-70B/30B variants with fallback to 13B/7B quantized. Want a plan for model routing: high-tier traffic -> high-precision model, degraded -> 4-bit variant; automated fallback when latency spike or capacity constrained.
po_proposal_notes: If Dedicated reserved capacity shows predictable p95 and cost < $X/1k tokens, customer is open to 12-month commit. Finance requires a comparative cost model and 2-week real-traffic shadowing results before signature.
